payload.claim: The "Out of scope" bullet about a DESIGN.md hand edit ("It now says five, and names this one... landed in this spec's pull request") describes a state that is already true at this base snapshot — DESIGN.md §4.2's gate-0 paragraph already lists five post-scan refusals and already names SA-0422's refusal by id, before this spec's own cell has run. Whatever hand edit this refers to already landed in an earlier commit, not in a pull request this spec's cell will produce. Since DESIGN.md is forbidden either way and the cell never touches it, this has no effect on what gets built — it only means the bullet's framing is slightly stale as a description of what still needs to happen.
